effect.name: Pixelate
effect.description: Snaps the image to a coarser grid. Useful both as a permanent look and as a transition - ramp the block size up to dissolve a scene into squares.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Block Width
parameter.description: Block width in texels. 1 leaves the image alone.

parameter.name: Block Height
parameter.description: Block height in texels. Set it to 1 with a wide block for a horizontal smear.

parameter.name: Sample Centre
parameter.description: On samples the middle of each block, which keeps thin features alive. Off samples the corner, which is the cheaper, blockier classic.
